description: This file implements the AttachSource class and related helper classes for managing media source capabilities and appsrc elements in a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It handles creation of media caps, switching audio sources, and interfacing with GStreamer wrappers.

classes.name: MediaSourceCapsBuilder
classes.description: Base class for building GStreamer caps for media sources, including common attributes like mime type, alignment, codec data, and stream format.

classes.name: MediaSourceAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building caps specific to audio media sources, including handling Opus and MPEG-specific configurations.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building caps specific to video media sources, including width and height.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoDolbyVisionCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building caps for Dolby Vision video sources, adding specific Dolby Vision properties.

classes.name: AttachSource
classes.description: Main class responsible for attaching media sources to the GStreamer pipeline, creating caps, managing appsrc elements, and switching sources as needed.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main logic to create caps, add or switch media sources in the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Creates and adds a new appsrc element to the pipeline for the given media source.

methods.name: updateSource
methods.description: Updates the caps of an existing appsrc element if they differ from the new caps.

methods.name: switchAudioSource
methods.description: Handles switching the audio source, including performing codec/channel switch via external utility.

methods.name: createCapsFromMediaSource
methods.description: Constructs GstCaps based on the media source type and configuration.

methods.name: createAudioAttributes
methods.description: Creates audio attributes used for switching audio tracks.
